jobs.title: Senior Test Manager - Core Banking & Pricing System Integration 100% (f/m/d) - (Contract through our external payroll partner with immediate start until 31.12.2027 with possible extension)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a Senior Test Manager to support the integration of an inhouse built pricing processing tool into a new core banking system. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing all testing activities to ensure software quality, compliance, and successful delivery within project timelines.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Plans, designs, and oversees software testing activities across the development lifecycle

• Defines test strategies, coordinates test environments, and ensures defect tracking

• Collaborates with development, business analysts, and project managers to align testing with project goals

• Manages functional, regression, and non-functional testing processes

• Co-ordinate test environment use

• Support test automation coverage and capability for automated regression testing

• Ensures compliance with quality standards, regulatory requirements, and best practices

• Leads and mentors test team members, promoting continuous improvement in test efficiency and coverage

YOUR PROFILE

• Proven experience as a Senior Test Manager or Senior Testing Lead in complex IT projects (min. 5 years) and preferred large core banking transformation projects

• Excellent knowledge of pricing in the banking sector incl. experience with testing of core banking fee engines (e.g. HOST/T24/Avaloq) or/and testing of satellites feeding into the fee engines

• Strong understanding of software testing methodologies (agile, waterfall) and test management tools (e.g., JIRA, HP ALM)

• Experience with test automation frameworks, in particular Selenium, CI/CD integration, and performance testing tools

• Java development experience incl. use of Claude Code

• Relevant certifications such as ISTQB Advanced Level, PMP, or Agile Testing are highly desirable

• Understanding of DevOps concepts such as CI/CD

• Good communication skills, problem solving, social interaction & cross-cultural mindset, empathy & can-do spirit

• Fast learner and understanding of business context

• You take pride of your work and strive to lead by example

• Able to communicate with business and technical stakeholders

• Fluency in English (verbal/written)

• Tech Stack: Java, Spring Boot, SQL (Oracle), React/Angular, JavaScript, Typescript, Kubernetes (PKS) and Virtual Machines, Streaming using Kafka, Avro, Open API, UML

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Over the past few years, pay and performance management at Julius Baer has undergone significant transformation. With the introduction of modern, market-leading compensation frameworks and a strengthened pay-for-performance culture—supported by agile ways of working—we are well positioned to support sustainable business success.

The Compensation & Performance Management (CPM) team is a key part of the broader Reward & Performance Management (RPM) function. Acting as the primary interface to our internal clients, CPM collaborates closely with HR and other specialist teams to provide expert advice on all performance-related matters.

• Support the execution of annual and cyclical performance management processes

• Act as a trusted advisor and sparring partner for HR stakeholders and business leaders

• Contribute to projects and initiatives aimed at enhancing performance frameworks, tools, and processes

• Help design, implement, and optimize new solutions within the performance management landscape

• Bring forward ideas to continuously improve processes, tools, and user experience

YOUR PROFILE
Personal & Social

• Resilient and able to perform effectively under pressure

• Proactive, self-motivated, and solution-oriented

• Confident communicator with strong problem-solving abilities

• Collaborative team player with a positive, can-do attitude

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field (Master’s preferred)

• Proven experience in performance management and/or project management

• Good understanding of the financial services or banking industry

• Fluent in English and German

jobs.title: Client Engagement Specialist, CIO, 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The CIO Office Client Engagement function is responsible for bringing Julius Baer’s investment capabilities and the CIO Office value proposition to life through high-quality client-facing materials, formats, and experiences. The role plays a key part in enabling sales efforts, supporting campaigns and product initiatives, and promoting discretionary solutions through consistent and impactful communication.

We are looking for a dynamic professional to drive client engagement and marketing activities within the CIO Office, ensuring CIO initiatives and content are effectively activated across channels to support client conversations and commercial outcomes.

The Client Engagement Specialist acts as a key point of contact for priority client materials and initiatives, providing expertise on communication formats and activation strategies, and collaborates closely with portfolio managers, investment analysts, and client-facing teams to ensure relevance and strong sales enablement.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Shape and execute CIO-aligned marketing and engagement initiatives, translating investment strategy and insights into client-relevant communication that supports sales and promotes discretionary solutions

• Design and deliver engaging content formats (e.g., newsletters, presentations, videos, webcasts, podcasts, events, digital content) to strengthen client discussions and sales conversations

• Produce, maintain and update high-quality client-facing materials and formats to actively promote discretionary solutions and investment insights

• Run marketing campaigns and product launches, ensuring effective positioning and adoption of discretionary offerings

• Monitor engagement, collect feedback, and track usage metrics to continuously improve effectiveness and commercial impact

• Contribute to the implementation of new tools and formats, including digital solutions and AI, to enhance efficiency and scalability

• Coordinate multi-channel content distribution (intranet, CRM, web, etc.) to maximize reach, engagement, and usage

• Stay current on market trends and the competitive landscape to shape content and marketing strategy

• Support internal education efforts and special projects that drive business growth

YOUR PROFILE

• University degree in marketing, business management, finance or equivalent field

• Strong understanding of investment products and financial markets

• 2-5 years of experience in delivering product marketing and client-facing content in a bank, asset manager or related financial services providers

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex investment concepts into clear, engaging, and client‑friendly messaging

• Proven experience in content creation and multi-channel communication

• Results-oriented mindset with focus on measurable impact

• Team player with demonstrated ability to collaborate within a cross‑functional environment

• Proactive, creative and driven individual with a can-do mindset

• Exceptional English and German written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative, solutions-oriented working style

• Willingness to drive innovation and improve processes, including effective use of technology/data/AI to increase quality, consistency, and speed

• Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) is a plus

jobs.title: System Engineer - Infrastructure Automation 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

At Julius Baer, we are committed to empowering our teams through a DevOps-driven approach. To achieve this, we are focused on developing scalable platforms that enable our product teams to self-serve their infrastructure and resource needs. As our application landscape evolves, we're investing in the expansion of our infrastructure automation capabilities.

Join our team as an Infrastructure Automation Expert and play a key role in designing and delivering automation solutions that drive efficiency across the organization by replacing manual processes with automated self-service offerings.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Lead the design, development, and implementation of automation solutions using vRealize (Aria) Automation and/or Crossplane to streamline IT processes and improve efficiency

• Develop and maintain vRealize (Aria) Orchestrator workflows as well as develop Crossplane providers and functions using Golang and the Kubernetes Operator pattern

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with business objectives and technical strategies

• Provide technical leadership and expertise to the team, and contribute to the development of technical roadmaps and strategic plans

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to vRealize Automation and Orchestration, and provide recommendations for improvements

• Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and technologies in cloud computing, virtualisation, and automation, and apply this knowledge to continuously improve our automation solutions

• Participate in the development of technical documentation, including design documents, implementation guides, and operational procedures

• Ensure compliance with industry standards, best practices, and organisational policies

YOUR PROFILE

• Minimum 2 years of experience developing and operating Kubernetes Operators, ideally using Golang and the Crossplane framework to provision and continuously reconcile resources

• Minimum 3 years of experience in designing, implementing, and managing automation solutions using vRealize (Aria) Automation, with a focus on large-scale enterprise environments

• Expert knowledge of Kubernetes and the cloud-native computing ecosystem

• Strong understanding of IT infrastructure including Windows, Linux, Active Directory, Cisco technologies, etc.

• Strong understanding of cloud computing, virtualisation, and automation technologies, including VMware vSphere, vCenter, and NSX

• Strong understanding of SW development processes, CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tools

• Strong understanding of IT service management frameworks such as ITIL, and experience with agile development methodologies and version control systems such as Git

• Experience with Golang and scripting languages such as Javascript, PowerShell or Python

• Proven track record of leading technical projects and teams, with experience in managing multiple stakeholders and vendors

• Excellent communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities and deadlines

• Ability to quickly grasp complex requirements, fast learner, highly proactive

• Proven track record in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer Logging SIEM Data Pipelines 100% (f/m/d) - (Contract through our external payroll partner with immediate start until 31.12.2026 with possible internalisation)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a senior security data engineer with deep expertise in SIEM platforms, telemetry pipelines, and security operations tooling to join our global team in Zurich. As the ideal candidate, you combine strong security foundations with a data engineering mindset and are comfortable architecting and operating high-volume, enterprise-scale logging and analytics infrastructure in a regulated financial services environment. You are proactive, technically curious, and thrive in both independent and collaborative work settings.

Your primary responsibilities will involve designing, operating, and evolving our centralised logging and SIEM platforms, building and maintaining data pipelines for intelligent log routing and enrichment, driving SOAR automation, and contributing to the expansion of our security data ecosystem — including early-stage observability use cases. You will work closely with security operations, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure reliable, high-quality data flows from source to insight.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• As part of a dedicated team, architect, operate, and continuously improve the Bank’s centralised logging and SIEM platforms, ensuring high availability, performance, and scalability for enterprise-grade data volumes

• Design, build, and maintain telemetry and data pipelines, enabling routing, enrichment, filtering, and multi-destination delivery of security and operational log data while maintaining cost-efficiency

• Drive the development and operationalisation of SOAR workflows to accelerate incident response, automate repetitive tasks, and improve security operations efficiency

• Develop and maintain service monitoring, detection content, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable security intelligence to stakeholders across the organisation

• Collaborate with security operations, IT infrastructure, and application teams to integrate new data sources, ensure data quality, and expand platform coverage — including early-stage contributions to observability use cases

• Maintain technical documentation including architecture descriptions, runbooks, data flow diagrams, and security parameterisations

• Coordinate the mitigation or resolution of security-relevant platform incidents with internal security stakeholders and external vendors

• Contribute to the development of architecture, standards, and best practices for the centralised logging and telemetry ecosystem

• Provide 2nd and 3rd level engineering support, including participation in an on-call rotation

YOUR PROFILE

• Highly proactive, solution-oriented, and results-driven with strong abstract and conceptual thinking skills

• Structured and goal-oriented approach to work, with the ability to independently assess, prioritise, and resolve complex tasks and requests

• Creative problem solver who challenges the status quo and proposes innovative solutions to existing issues

• Strong communicator who can translate technical complexity into clear guidance for platform users, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams

• Contribute to the development of architecture, concepts, and processes related to the Centralised Logging and Telemetry ecosystem

• Comfortable working across multiple application, infrastructure, and business teams

• Willingness and curiosity to learn new technologies and approaches in a rapidly evolving landscape

• University degree or higher technical education (university of applied sciences, federal diploma) in Computer Science, Information Security, or related discipline — or equivalent practical experience

• Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience engineering and administering enterprise SIEM platforms, with experience developing detection content, correlation searches, dashboards, and CIM-normalised data models

• Strong experience designing and operating data pipelines and log routing infrastructure, ideally with Cribl Stream or comparable telemetry pipeline tools

• Practical scripting and automation skills with one or more of: Python, Bash/Shell, JavaScript

• Working experience with GIT, SQL, REST APIs, and regular expressions

• Solid understanding of SOAR platforms and security operations automation

• Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible is an advantage

• Fluent written and spoken English

• Good knowledge of German is a strong plus

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

Als idealer Kandidat kombinieren Sie starke Sicherheitsgrundlagen mit einer Data-Engineering-Mentalität und sind komfortabel bei der Architektur und dem Betrieb einer großvolumigen, unternehmensweiten Protokollierungs- und Analyseinfrastruktur in einer regulierten Finanzdienstleistungsumgebung. IHRE HINWEISE

• Als Teil eines engagierten Teams können Sie die zentralisierten Logging- und SIEM-Plattformen der Bank erstellen, betreiben und kontinuierlich verbessern, um eine hohe Verfügbarkeit, Leistung und Skalierbarkeit für Datenmengen von Unternehmen zu gewährleisten.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Sicherheitsoperationen, IT-Infrastruktur und Anwendungsteams, um neue Datenquellen zu integrieren, die Datenqualität zu gewährleisten und die Plattformabdeckung zu erweitern - einschließlich frühzeitiger Beiträge zu Anwendungsfällen für die Beobachtbarkeit

• Koordinierung der Minderung oder Behebung sicherheitsrelevanter Plattformvorfälle mit internen Sicherheitsakteuren und externen Anbietern

• Bereitstellung von Engineering-Support auf der 2. und 3. Ebene, einschließlich der Teilnahme an einer On-Call-Rotation

• Strukturierter und zielorientierter Arbeitsansatz mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Aufgaben und Anforderungen unabhängig zu bewerten, zu priorisieren und zu lösen

• Kreativer Problemlöser, der den Status Quo herausfordert und innovative Lösungen für bestehende Probleme vorschlägt

• Starker Kommunikator, der technische Komplexität in klare Leitlinien für Plattformbenutzer, Stakeholder und funktionsübergreifende Teams übersetzen kann

• Beitrag zur Entwicklung von Architektur, Konzepten und Prozessen im Zusammenhang mit dem Ökosystem Centralized Logging and Telemetry

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. Laissez-les façonner ensemble l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

Nous recherchons un ingénieur principal en données de sécurité avec une expertise approfondie dans les plateformes SIEM, les pipelines de télémétrie et les opérations de sécurité pour rejoindre notre équipe mondiale à Zurich. En tant que candidat idéal, vous combinez de solides fondations de sécurité avec un état d'esprit d'ingénierie de données et êtes confortable d'architecte et d'exploitation d'une infrastructure d'exploitation et d'analyse à grande échelle dans un environnement de services financiers réglementés. Vous êtes proactif, techniquement curieux et prospère dans des environnements de travail indépendants et collaboratifs.

Vos responsabilités principales consisteront à concevoir, à exploiter et à développer nos plateformes centralisées d'exploitation forestière et SIEM, à construire et à entretenir des pipelines de données pour le routage et l'enrichissement intelligents des registres, à conduire l'automatisation SOAR et à contribuer à l'expansion de notre écosystème de données de sécurité, y compris les cas d'utilisation d'observation en début de phase. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes chargées des opérations de sécurité, de l'infrastructure et de l'application pour assurer un flux fiable et de haute qualité de données de la source à la perspicacité.

VOTRE DÉFIS

• Dans le cadre d'une équipe dédiée, architecte, exploite et améliore en permanence les plateformes centralisées d'exploitation forestière et SIEM de la Banque, assurant une disponibilité élevée, des performances et une évolutivité pour les volumes de données de qualité entreprise

• Concevoir, construire et entretenir des pipelines de télémétrie et de données, en permettant l'acheminement, l'enrichissement, le filtrage et la livraison multidestination de données de sécurité et de registre opérationnel tout en maintenant l'efficacité économique

• Conduire le développement et l'opérationnalisation des workflows SOAR pour accélérer la réponse aux incidents, automatiser les tâches répétitives et améliorer l'efficacité des opérations de sécurité

• Élaborer et maintenir des services de surveillance, de détection du contenu, des rapports et des tableaux de bord qui fournissent des renseignements de sécurité exploitables aux parties prenantes de l'organisation

• Collaborer avec les opérations de sécurité, l'infrastructure informatique et les équipes d'application afin d'intégrer de nouvelles sources de données, d'assurer la qualité des données et d'élargir la couverture de la plate-forme, y compris les contributions en phase initiale aux cas d'utilisation de l'observation

• Maintenez une documentation technique comprenant des descriptions d'architecture, des runbooks, des diagrammes de flux de données et des paramétrisations de sécurité

• Coordonner l'atténuation ou le règlement des incidents liés aux plates-formes de sécurité avec les intervenants en matière de sécurité interne et les fournisseurs externes

• Contribuer au développement de l'architecture, des normes et des meilleures pratiques pour l'écosystème centralisé d'exploitation forestière et de télémétrie

• Fournir un soutien technique de 2e et 3e niveaux, y compris la participation à une rotation sur appel

VOTRE PROFIL

• Très proactif, axé sur la solution et axé sur les résultats, doté de solides compétences de réflexion abstraite et conceptuelle

• Approche structurée et axée sur les objectifs, avec la capacité d'évaluer de façon indépendante, de hiérarchiser et de résoudre les tâches et les demandes complexes

• Résolveur de problèmes créatif qui conteste le statu quo et propose des solutions innovantes aux problèmes existants

• Un communicateur fort capable de traduire la complexité technique en orientations claires pour les utilisateurs de la plateforme, les parties prenantes et les équipes interfonctionnelles

• Contribuer au développement de l'architecture, des concepts et des processus liés à l'écosystème de l'exploitation forestière centralisée et de la télémétrie

• Travail confortable entre plusieurs équipes d'application, d'infrastructure et d'affaires

• Volonté et curiosité d'apprendre de nouvelles technologies et approches dans un paysage en évolution rapide

• Diplôme universitaire ou enseignement technique supérieur (université des sciences appliquées, diplôme fédéral) en informatique, sécurité de l'information ou discipline connexe — ou expérience pratique équivalente

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience pratique en ingénierie et en administration de plateformes SIEM d'entreprise, avec une expérience de développement de contenus de détection, de recherches de corrélation, de tableaux de bord et de modèles de données normalisés CIM

• Forte expérience dans la conception et l'exploitation de pipelines de données et d'infrastructures de routage des journaux, idéalement avec Cribl Stream ou des outils de pipeline de télémétrie comparables

• Compétences pratiques de script et d'automatisation avec un ou plusieurs de : Python, Bash/Shell, JavaScript

• Expérience de travail avec GIT, SQL, API REST et expressions régulières

• Une bonne compréhension des plateformes SOAR et de l'automatisation des opérations de sécurité

• Expérience avec des outils de gestion de configuration comme Ansible est un avantage

• Langue écrite et parlée

• Une bonne connaissance de l'allemand est un plus fort

jobs.title: Application Integration Engineer 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Application Integration Engineer is responsible for the development, implementation, and operational support of FIX integration solutions and Order Trade Flows on the company’s Financial Messaging Infrastructure (BCOM). The role includes project participation, customer onboarding, monitoring and automation initiatives (meshIQ), and collaboration with both internal and external stakeholders.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Role Responsibilities:

FIX & Messaging Integration

• Develop, configure, and maintain FIX integrations using ITIVI APPIA FIX, IBM MQ, and IBM ACE

• Configure FIX sessions, protocol parameters, and connectivity for clients, brokers, and exchanges

• Develop and maintain message flows within the existing middleware architecture

• Design, coordinate, and execute FIX certification tests for onboarding clients and exchanges

Engineering & Project Support

• Support project requests from the Markets environment (Front Office, Trading, Brokerage)

• Analyze new client-specific requirements and design corresponding integration solutions

• Perform detailed root‑cause analysis in the event of production incidents

• Provide technical expertise during the client onboarding process

Operations & On‑Call Duty

• Ensure stable and continuous operation of the FIX and MQ messaging landscape

• Contribute to monitoring and automation initiatives using meshIQ products

• Participate in the team’s rotating 24/7 on‑call service

YOUR PROFILE
Education:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science (university or university of applied sciences), or equivalent proven technical expertise

Technical Skills:

• 5+ years of hands‑on experience with the FIX protocol, including deep knowledge of Order/Trade Flows, FIX-Engine and Frameworks

• Solid Linux proficiency

• Programming skills in at least one language: ESQL, Bash, Perl, Java

• Strong experience with MQ client/broker connectivity and related industry standards

• Proven expertise in developing integration solutions in a banking environment using: IBM MQ, IBM Integration Bus (IIB), IBM ACE

• Experience with client and exchange connectivity in financial markets

• Good understanding of key financial products (Equities, FX, Derivatives)

• Knowledge of SWIFT (ISO20022 / MT / MX) is considered an advantage

Soft Skills:

• Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders

• Analytical mindset with structured problem‑solving capabilities

• Ability to work independently in both project environments and 24/7 operational settings

• Service‑oriented attitude and readiness to take ownership of technical issues

jobs.title: Mortgage Officer 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

As a Mortgage Officer, you will act as the second line of defense in mortgage underwriting and servicing for domestic and international private banking clients. You will assess credit risk, ensure compliance, and support the front line in delivering sound mortgage solutions. This interesting role combines risk oversight with operational excellence, requiring close collaboration with Mortgage Advisors, Relationship Managers, and internal stakeholders.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Evaluate mortgage requests within personal approval authority, assessing borrower creditworthiness, collateral, and structural risks

• Provide qualified feedback and recommendations to Mortgage Advisors and Relationship Managers

• Ensure all transactions meet legal, regulatory, and internal requirements

• Perform servicing and lifecycle administration of active mortgage facilities, including modifications and renewals

• Drive data quality improvements across current and new mortgage positions

• Contribute to process optimisation and operational excellence in close cooperation with stakeholders

• Maintain regular contact with Mortgage Advisors, the Julius Baer Real Estate Team, and Relationship Managers to support efficient transaction execution

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, or related field; or relevant professional experience considered

• 3–5+ years of experience in mortgage lending, ideally within a private banking or wealth management environment

• Solid understanding of mortgage underwriting, product structures, and risk mitigation techniques

• Familiarity with Swiss banking regulations and frameworks

• Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality results

• A collaborative mindset with strong communication skills — proven ability to work effectively as a team player in cross-functional environments

• Fluency in German or English, coupled with demonstrable proficiency in French or Italian, is strongly preferred

jobs.description:

• Experience with test automation frameworks, CI/CD integration, and performance testing tools

• Solid knowledge of financial systems, e.g. regulatory reporting, risk reporting, and similar (preferred)

• Relevant certifications such as ISTQB Advanced Level, PMP, or Agile Testing are highly desirable

• Understanding of DevOps concepts such as CI/CD and the importance and value of automated testing

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

• Willingness to learn new ways of working while supporting Julius Baer in its transformation

• You take pride in your work and strive to lead by example

• Cross-cultural mindset, empathy, and can-do spirit

• Fast learner with understanding of business context

• Able to communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders

• Fluent in English; German is a nice-to-have

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are looking for a Business Analyst to help design, implement, and optimize Management Accounting processes as part of a large, strategic transformation initiative. This role is ideal for a professional with solid experience in management accounting, strong exposure to internal reporting, Markets and Treasury processes, and hands-on familiarity with requirements gathering, gap analysis, process design, and reconciliation—ideally within the SAP environment.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Responsible for collecting, analysing, and documenting business requirements related to Management Accounting processes, including reconciliation of Balance Sheet and P&L figures and detailed investigation and resolution of variances

• Drive project-based design, implementation, and enhancement of end-to-end Management Accounting processes, with a particular focus on allocation framework, P&L and key KPIs reporting

• Translate business requirements into clear business and functional concepts, develop detailed specifications, prepare test case with acceptance criteria, and execute user acceptance testing within program timelines

• Support project-related financial reconciliations, analyse deviations identified during testing or go‑live phases, and contribute to root-cause analysis and remediation activities

• Contribute to project delivery and operational continuity by supporting and deputizing team members across Management Accounting and Finance Analytics

YOUR PROFILE

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in business administration, finance, or a related field

• At least 2-5 years of professional experience in management accounting or internal reporting, ideally within the banking industry

• Self-starter with ability to grasp quickly and efficiently new and complex processes and having regard to changing priorities

• Reliable and flexible team player with a can-do attitude, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and an enthusiasm for working in a dynamic environment

• Strong interest in financial topics, with a particular appreciation for areas such as Credits, Markets, and Treasury considered an advantage

• Passion for financials and IT with deep understanding of SAP financial systems; prior knowledge of SAP PaPM is a distinct advantage

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, along with strong interpersonal abilities, to foster effective collaboration across diverse functions and stakeholders

• Fluent in English is required, German is a plus

jobs.title: Structured Products Sales, Zürich, 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

At Julius Baer, we empower our clients to achieve their most sophisticated financial aspirations through bespoke, insight-driven solutions. As a leading global wealth manager, we combine deep market expertise with an entrepreneurial spirit to deliver exceptional value, not only to our clients, but also to our people.

We are seeking a driven and knowledgeable Structured Products Sales, to join our Global Products & Solutions (GPS) unit, in Zürich.

In this pivotal role, you will act as a strategic partner to relationship managers and investment advisors, designing and promoting innovative, cross-asset structured solutions tailored to the unique objectives of ultra-high-net-worth clients.

More than just a product expert, you will be a trusted enabler of client conversations, providing actionable ideas, anticipating market trends, and actively contributing to the growth and evolution of our structured products offering. This is a collaborative, front-office position where technical excellence meets commercial impact.

You bring proven sales experience from a leading financial institution, possess strong analytical capabilities, and have a genuine passion for creating value through structured investments.

Fluent in German and deeply familiar with the Swiss private banking landscape, you are equally committed to strengthening internal partnerships as you are to driving results.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Contribute to the growth of the book, with a focus on the Swiss German markets

• Provide expert advice to Relationship Managers and Investment Advisors on tailored investment solutions, with a focus on Structured Products, to meet client needs

• Identify emerging market trends and develop innovative investment strategies to expand our client offerings

• Design, price, and launch structured products based on equity, credit, and interest rate underlings

• Proactively manage product rollovers, notifying Relationship Managers and Investment Advisors of impending maturities and offering suitable replacement options

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders through regular desk meetings and advisory calls to promote Structured Products and drive business growth

• Deliver educational sessions to Relationship Managers to enhance their knowledge of Structured Products and improve sales effectiveness

• Contribute to the development of marketing materials that showcase investment ideas and opportunities

• Oversee day-to-day operations, including trade booking, post-sale support, and product lifecycle management

YOUR PROFILE

• Education: Bachelor's or master’s degree in Banking & Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field

• Experience: Minimum 3-5 years of experience in an advisory or sales role, with P&l KPI

• Sales Drive: Results-driven mindset with a proven track-record in successfully developing clients / RM collaborations, and a strong desire to succeed in a sales-oriented environment

• Market Knowledge: Strong passion for financial markets, with a broad understanding of various asset classes and in-depth expertise in at least one area

• Structured Products Expertise: Advanced knowledge of Structured Products, including their design, pricing, and application

• Client Focus: Ability to analyse client situations, identify needs, and develop tailored solutions

• Communication Skills: Skilled in simplifying complex concepts and creating engaging advisory materials to support sales efforts

• Team Collaboration: Strong team player with excellent interpersonal skills, able to work effectively with colleagues and clients

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in programming languages such as Python and VBA, with the ability to apply technical skills to analyse and solve complex problems

• Language Proficiency: Fluency in German and English

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

Ruolo: Structured Products Sales, Zürich, 100% (f/m/d).

Julius Baer è uno dei principali gruppi bancari privati svizzeri con sede a Zurigo e uffici a Lugano, Ticino.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements.

Bei Julius Bär befähigen wir unsere Kunden, ihre anspruchsvollsten finanziellen Ziele durch maßgeschneiderte, aufschlussreiche Lösungen zu erreichen. Als führender globaler Vermögensverwalter kombinieren wir fundierte Marktexpertise mit Unternehmergeist, um nicht nur unseren Kunden, sondern auch unseren Mitarbeitern einen außergewöhnlichen Mehrwert zu bieten.

Wir suchen einen zielgerichteten und sachkundigen Structured Products Sales, der Teil unserer Global Products & Solutions (GPS) Einheit in Zürich wird.

In dieser zentralen Rolle agieren Sie als strategischer Partner von Relationship Managern und Anlageberatern und entwerfen und fördern innovative, vermögensübergreifende strukturierte Lösungen, die auf die einzigartigen Ziele von ultra-vermögenden Kunden zugeschnitten sind.

Mehr als nur ein Produktexperte, Sie werden ein zuverlässiger Wegbereiter für Kundengespräche sein, umsetzbare Ideen liefern, Markttrends antizipieren und aktiv zum Wachstum und zur Entwicklung unseres strukturierten Produktangebots beitragen. Dies ist eine kollaborative Front-Office-Position, in der technische Exzellenz auf kommerzielle Auswirkungen trifft.

Sie bringen bewährte Verkaufserfahrung von einem führenden Finanzinstitut mit, verfügen über starke analytische Fähigkeiten und haben eine echte Leidenschaft für die Wertschöpfung durch strukturierte Anlagen.

Fließend in Deutsch und mit der Schweizer Private-Banking-Landschaft bestens vertraut, engagieren Sie sich ebenso für die Stärkung interner Partnerschaften wie für die Ergebnissteigerung.

IHRE HINWEISE

• Beitrag zum Wachstum des Buches, mit Fokus auf den schweizerischen deutschen Märkten

• Beratung von Relationship Managern und Anlageberatern zu maßgeschneiderten Anlagelösungen mit Schwerpunkt auf strukturierten Produkten, um die Bedürfnisse der Kunden zu erfüllen

• Identifizieren Sie aufstrebende Markttrends und entwickeln Sie innovative Anlagestrategien, um unser Kundenangebot zu erweitern

• Design, Preis und Einführung strukturierter Produkte basierend auf Aktien-, Kredit- und Zinsunterlegungen

• Produkt-Rollover proaktiv verwalten, Relationship Manager und Anlageberater über bevorstehende Laufzeiten informieren und geeignete Ersatzoptionen anbieten

• Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern durch regelmäßige Desk-Meetings und Beratungsgespräche zur Förderung strukturierter Produkte und zur Förderung des Geschäftswachstums

• Bereitstellung von Schulungen für Relationship Manager, um ihr Wissen über strukturierte Produkte zu verbessern und die Verkaufseffektivität zu verbessern

• Beitrag zur Entwicklung von Marketingmaterialien, die Anlageideen und -möglichkeiten präsentieren

• Überwachung des täglichen Betriebs, einschließlich Handelsbuchung, Support nach dem Verkauf und Produktlebenszyklusmanagement

IHR PROFIL

• Ausbildung: Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Banking & Finance, Economics, Business Administration oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Erfahrung: Mindestens 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Beratungs- oder Vertriebsrolle, mit P&l KPI

• Sales Drive: Ergebnisorientierte Denkweise mit nachgewiesener Erfolgsbilanz bei der erfolgreichen Entwicklung von Kunden / RM-Kollaborationen und dem starken Wunsch, in einem vertriebsorientierten Umfeld erfolgreich zu sein

• Marktkenntnisse: Starke Leidenschaft für Finanzmärkte, mit einem breiten Verständnis verschiedener Anlageklassen und fundierter Expertise in mindestens einem Bereich

• Expertise Strukturierte Produkte: Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse über Strukturierte Produkte, einschließlich Design, Preisgestaltung und Anwendung

• Kundenfokus: Fähigkeit, Kundensituationen zu analysieren, Bedürfnisse zu identifizieren und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen zu entwickeln

• Kommunikationsfähigkeiten: Fähigkeit, komplexe Konzepte zu vereinfachen und ansprechende Beratungsmaterialien zur Unterstützung der Vertriebsbemühungen zu erstellen

• Team Collaboration: Starker Teamplayer mit hervorragenden zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten, der in der Lage ist, effektiv mit Kollegen und Kunden zu arbeiten

• Technische Fähigkeiten: Kenntnisse in Programmiersprachen wie Python und VBA mit der Fähigkeit, technische Fähigkeiten anzuwenden, um komplexe Probleme zu analysieren und zu lösen

• Sprachkenntnisse: fließend in Deutsch und Englisch

Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. Laissez-les façonner ensemble l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

Chez Julius Baer, nous responsabilisons nos clients à réaliser leurs aspirations financières les plus sophistiquées grâce à des solutions sur mesure et inspirées par les idées. En tant que chef de file mondial en matière de gestion de patrimoine, nous associons une expertise de marché profonde à un esprit d'entreprise pour offrir une valeur exceptionnelle, non seulement à nos clients, mais aussi à nos collaborateurs.

Nous recherchons une vente de produits structurés performante et compétente, pour rejoindre notre unité Global Products & Solutions (GPS) à Zurich.

Dans ce rôle central, vous jouerez le rôle de partenaire stratégique pour les gestionnaires de relations et les conseillers en placement, en concevant et en faisant la promotion de solutions structurées innovantes et croisées adaptées aux objectifs uniques des clients ultra-hauts de gamme.

Plus qu'un simple expert en produits, vous serez un catalyseur fiable de conversations client, fournissant des idées actionnables, anticipant les tendances du marché et contribuant activement à la croissance et à l'évolution de notre offre de produits structurés. Il s'agit d'un poste de premier plan collaboratif où l'excellence technique répond à l'impact commercial.

Vous apportez une expérience de vente éprouvée d'une institution financière de premier plan, possèdez de solides capacités d'analyse et avez une véritable passion pour créer de la valeur grâce à des investissements structurés.

Fluent en allemand et profondément familier avec le paysage bancaire privé suisse, vous êtes tout aussi déterminé à renforcer les partenariats internes que vous êtes à conduire les résultats.

VOTRE DÉFIS

• Contribuer à la croissance du livre, en mettant l'accent sur les marchés allemands suisses

• Fournir des conseils spécialisés aux gestionnaires de relations et aux conseillers en investissement sur des solutions d'investissement sur mesure, en mettant l'accent sur les produits structurés, pour répondre aux besoins des clients

• Identifier les nouvelles tendances du marché et élaborer des stratégies d'investissement novatrices pour élargir les offres de nos clients

• Conception, prix et lancement de produits structurés basés sur des fonds propres, des crédits et des sous-produits de taux d'intérêt

• Gérer proactivement les roulements de produits, informer les gestionnaires de relations et les conseillers en investissement des échéances imminentes et offrir des options de remplacement appropriées

• Collaborer avec les intervenants internes au moyen de réunions régulières et d'appels consultatifs pour promouvoir les produits structurés et stimuler la croissance des entreprises

• Offrir des séances d'éducation aux gestionnaires de relations afin d'améliorer leurs connaissances sur les produits structurés et l'efficacité des ventes

• Contribuer à l'élaboration de matériel de commercialisation présentant des idées et des possibilités d'investissement

• Surveiller les opérations quotidiennes, y compris la réservation commerciale, le soutien après-vente et la gestion du cycle de vie des produits

VOTRE PROFIL

• Éducation: Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en banque et finance, économie, administration des affaires, ou un domaine connexe

• Expérience : Au moins 3 à 5 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de conseil ou de vente, avec P&l KPI

• Sales Drive : un état d'esprit axé sur les résultats avec un record de piste éprouvé dans le développement réussi de clients / collaborations RM, et un vif désir de réussir dans un environnement axé sur les ventes

• Connaissance des marchés : Une forte passion pour les marchés financiers, avec une compréhension large des différentes classes d'actifs et une expertise approfondie dans au moins un domaine

• Expertise en produits structurés : Connaissances avancées des produits structurés, y compris leur conception, leur prix et leur application

• Orientation client : Capacité d'analyser les situations clientes, d'identifier les besoins et d'élaborer des solutions adaptées

• Compétences en communication : Compétences pour simplifier des concepts complexes et créer des documents consultatifs pour soutenir les efforts de vente

• Collaboration d'équipe : Joueur fort avec d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, capable de travailler efficacement avec ses collègues et ses clients

• Compétences techniques : Compétence en langages de programmation tels que Python et VBA, avec la capacité d'appliquer des compétences techniques pour analyser et résoudre des problèmes complexes

• Connaissance des langues: maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer Logging SIEM Data Pipelines 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a senior security data engineer with deep expertise in SIEM platforms, telemetry pipelines, and security operations tooling to join our global team in Zurich. As the ideal candidate, you combine strong security foundations with a data engineering mindset and are comfortable architecting and operating high-volume, enterprise-scale logging and analytics infrastructure in a regulated financial services environment. You are proactive, technically curious, and thrive in both independent and collaborative work settings.
Your primary responsibilities will involve designing, operating, and evolving our centralised logging and SIEM platforms, building and maintaining data pipelines for intelligent log routing and enrichment, driving SOAR automation, and contributing to the expansion of our security data ecosystem — including early-stage observability use cases. You will work closely with security operations, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure reliable, high-quality data flows from source to insight.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• As part of a dedicated team, architect, operate, and continuously improve the Bank’s centralised logging and SIEM platforms, ensuring high availability, performance, and

• scalability for enterprise-grade data volumes

• Design, build, and maintain telemetry and data pipelines, enabling routing, enrichment, filtering, and multi-destination delivery of security and operational log data while maintaining

• cost-efficiency

• Drive the development and operationalisation of SOAR workflows to accelerate incident response, automate repetitive tasks, and improve security operations efficiency

• Develop and maintain service monitoring, detection content, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable security intelligence to stakeholders across the organisation

• Collaborate with security operations, IT infrastructure, and application teams to integrate new data sources, ensure data quality, and expand platform coverage — including early-stage

• contributions to observability use cases

• Maintain technical documentation including architecture descriptions, runbooks, data flow diagrams, and security parameterisations

• Coordinate the mitigation or resolution of security-relevant platform incidents with internal security stakeholders and external vendors

• Contribute to the development of architecture, standards, and best practices for the centralised logging and telemetry ecosystem

• Provide 2nd and 3rd level engineering support, including participation in an on-call rotation

YOUR PROFILE

• Highly proactive, solution-oriented, and results-driven with strong abstract and conceptual thinking skills

• Structured and goal-oriented approach to work, with the ability to independently assess, prioritise, and resolve complex tasks and requests

• Creative problem solver who challenges the status quo and proposes innovative solutions to existing issues

• Strong communicator who can translate technical complexity into clear guidance for platform users, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams

• Contribute to the development of architecture, concepts, and processes related to the Centralised Logging and Telemetry ecosystem

• Comfortable working across multiple application, infrastructure, and business teams

• Willingness and curiosity to learn new technologies and approaches in a rapidly evolving landscape

• University degree or higher technical education (university of applied sciences, federal diploma) in Computer Science, Information Security, or related discipline — or equivalent

• practical experience

• Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience engineering and administering enterprise SIEM platforms, with experience developing detection content, correlation searches, dashboards,

• and CIM-normalised data models

• Strong experience designing and operating data pipelines and log routing infrastructure, ideally with Cribl Stream or comparable telemetry pipeline tools

• Practical scripting and automation skills with one or more of: Python, Bash/Shell, JavaScript

• Working experience with GIT, SQL, REST APIs, and regular expressions

• Solid understanding of SOAR platforms and security operations automation

• Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible is an advantage

• Fluent written and spoken English

• Good knowledge of German is a strong plus

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

Nous recherchons un ingénieur principal en données de sécurité avec une expertise approfondie dans les plateformes SIEM, les pipelines de télémétrie et les opérations de sécurité pour rejoindre notre équipe mondiale à Zurich. En tant que candidat idéal, vous combinez de solides fondations de sécurité avec un état d'esprit d'ingénierie de données et êtes confortable d'architecte et d'exploitation d'une infrastructure d'exploitation et d'analyse à grande échelle dans un environnement de services financiers réglementés. Vous êtes proactif, techniquement curieux et prospère dans des environnements de travail indépendants et collaboratifs.
Vos responsabilités principales consisteront à concevoir, à exploiter et à développer nos plateformes centralisées d'exploitation forestière et SIEM, à construire et à entretenir des pipelines de données pour le routage et l'enrichissement intelligents des registres, à conduire l'automatisation SOAR et à contribuer à l'expansion de notre écosystème de données de sécurité, y compris les cas d'utilisation d'observation en début de phase. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes chargées des opérations de sécurité, de l'infrastructure et de l'application pour assurer un flux fiable et de haute qualité de données de la source à la perspicacité.

VOTRE DÉFIS

• Dans le cadre d'une équipe dédiée, architecte, exploite et améliore en permanence les plateformes centralisées d'exploitation forestière et SIEM de la Banque, assurant une disponibilité élevée, des performances et

• scalabilité pour les volumes de données de qualité entreprise

• Concevoir, construire et entretenir des pipelines de télémétrie et de données, permettant l'acheminement, l'enrichissement, le filtrage et la livraison multidestination des données de sécurité et de registre opérationnel tout en maintenant

• coût-efficacité

• Conduire le développement et l'opérationnalisation des workflows SOAR pour accélérer la réponse aux incidents, automatiser les tâches répétitives et améliorer l'efficacité des opérations de sécurité

• Élaborer et maintenir des services de surveillance, de détection du contenu, des rapports et des tableaux de bord qui fournissent des renseignements de sécurité exploitables aux parties prenantes de l'organisation

• Collaborer avec les opérations de sécurité, l'infrastructure informatique et les équipes d'application afin d'intégrer de nouvelles sources de données, d'assurer la qualité des données et d'étendre la couverture des plateformes, y compris les premières étapes

• contributions aux cas d'utilisation de l'observation

• Maintenez une documentation technique comprenant des descriptions d'architecture, des runbooks, des diagrammes de flux de données et des paramétrisations de sécurité

• Coordonner l'atténuation ou le règlement des incidents liés aux plates-formes de sécurité avec les intervenants en matière de sécurité interne et les fournisseurs externes

• Contribuer au développement de l'architecture, des normes et des meilleures pratiques pour l'écosystème centralisé d'exploitation forestière et de télémétrie

• Fournir un soutien technique de 2e et 3e niveaux, y compris la participation à une rotation sur appel

VOTRE PROFIL

• Très proactif, axé sur la solution et axé sur les résultats, doté de solides compétences de réflexion abstraite et conceptuelle

• Approche structurée et axée sur les objectifs, avec la capacité d'évaluer de façon indépendante, de hiérarchiser et de résoudre les tâches et les demandes complexes

• Résolveur de problèmes créatif qui conteste le statu quo et propose des solutions innovantes aux problèmes existants

• Un communicateur fort capable de traduire la complexité technique en orientations claires pour les utilisateurs de la plateforme, les parties prenantes et les équipes interfonctionnelles

• Contribuer au développement de l'architecture, des concepts et des processus liés à l'écosystème de l'exploitation forestière centralisée et de la télémétrie

• Travail confortable entre plusieurs équipes d'application, d'infrastructure et d'affaires

• Volonté et curiosité d'apprendre de nouvelles technologies et approches dans un paysage en évolution rapide

• Diplôme universitaire ou enseignement technique supérieur (université des sciences appliquées, diplôme fédéral) en informatique, sécurité de l'information ou discipline connexe — ou équivalent

• expérience pratique

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience pratique en ingénierie et en administration des plateformes SIEM d'entreprise, avec une expérience de développement de contenu de détection, de recherches de corrélation, de tableaux de bord,

• et modèles de données normalisés CIM

• Forte expérience dans la conception et l'exploitation de pipelines de données et d'infrastructures de routage des journaux, idéalement avec Cribl Stream ou des outils de pipeline de télémétrie comparables

• Compétences pratiques de script et d'automatisation avec un ou plusieurs de : Python, Bash/Shell, JavaScript

• Expérience de travail avec GIT, SQL, API REST et expressions régulières

• Une bonne compréhension des plateformes SOAR et de l'automatisation des opérations de sécurité

• Expérience avec des outils de gestion de configuration comme Ansible est un avantage

• Langue écrite et parlée

• Une bonne connaissance de l'allemand est un plus fort

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Leads end-to-end testing activities for a large Finance programme, including planning, scheduling, and execution of SIT, UAT, integration testing, and dress rehearsals, ensuring full alignment with the overarching change roadmap timelines and Finance-specific requirements

• Designs and develops comprehensive test cases, scripts, and acceptance criteria in collaboration with business SMEs and IT teams, ensuring full traceability to functional requirements and critical financial controls

• Manages test data and environment readiness, overseeing data anonymisation, provisioning, and environment validation across all stages (DEV to PROD), while ensuring compliance with data privacy standards and system interdependencies

• Coordinates defect management using tools like JIRA, tracks defect resolution, performs root cause analysis, and provides regular quality reporting - including defect trends, open risks, and test progress - to support informed Go/No-Go decisions

• Serves as the central point of contact during testing phase, supports UAT facilitation and sign-off, maintains cutover and rollback documentation, and provides hyper-care assistance to ensure a smooth transition and post-go-live stability

• Guiding business testers through the test process, including trainings in the use of Jira/xRay and creation of test cases

• Deputy of the Test Stream Lead

YOUR PROFILE

• Proven experience in software testing and quality assurance within large-scale IT or transformation projects, ideally in a financial services environment; strong familiarity with system implementation lifecycles (e.g., Agile, Waterfall) and testing best practices

• Extensive hands-on experience in managing end-to-end testing processes, including test planning, test case design, defect management, and execution of various testing types—SIT, UAT, regression, and end-to-end integration testing

• Solid understanding of financial systems and processes, particularly in areas such as Financial and Management Accounting, Treasury or Pricing, prior exposure to core banking platforms like Temenos T24 (Transact) or SAP is highly desirable

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail in validating system behaviour against business requirements, identifying gaps, and ensuring traceability from requirements to test coverage and defect resolution

• Excellent coordination and communication abilities, with experience acting as a liaison between business users, IT teams, and project stakeholders; capable of preparing clear test reports, leading testing sessions, supporting UAT, and contributing to Go/No-Go decisions

• Strong Jira and xRay knowledge

• Seniority to represent Finance interest in large scale programmes

• Hands-on experience in delivering projects requirements pragmatically and managing complex dependencies

• Fluency in English is required, proficiency in German is an advantage

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Senior IT Controller 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior IT Controller who is passionate about driving financial and operational governance, as well as project management office topics for the Group’s Technology area. You will join a dynamic and experienced team within the COO Chief of Staff unit, comprised of experts who act as sparring partners to the COO senior management, supporting them in achieving their objectives and vision around Run-the-Bank (RtB) and Change-the-Bank (CtB).

In this challenging and exciting role, you will be part of the IT Controlling & Management Support team and report to the Head of IT Controlling & Management Support.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Take a lead role in Run-the-Bank (RtB) and Change-the-Bank (CtB) financial reporting, planning and closing activities

• Conduct and/or coordinate quantitative and qualitative analyses as a decision basis for RtB and CtB portfolio

• Lead and/or support strategic initiatives and projects, collaborating across teams and functions – such as Finance, Group IT, Transformation Office etc.

• Lead and/or support transformational activities related to front-to-back processes and governance topics

• Execute ad-hoc senior management level requests and analyses

• Prepare highly visible & storytelling-driven presentations to different bodies & stakeholders across the Group

YOUR PROFILE

• Strong academic record: University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Econometrics or comparable field of study with above-average grades

• At least 5-7 years of experience in a comparable or related function within banking / background in consulting with a focus on technology / banking / finance sector

• Strong interest in Technology, Private Banking and Finance

• Outstanding analytical, conceptual and problem-solving skills with a strong affinity to quantitative modelling

• Excellent Excel & PowerPoint skills are a must. Programming skills (e.g. VBA / Python / SQL / R) as well as data visualization / business intelligence tools knowledge (e.g. Tableau) are a plus

• Strong personal drive with great organizational and multi-tasking skills as well as ability to work under pressure and in a fast-paced environment

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with multiple senior stakeholders and proven project management skills

• Fluent in German & English (spoken and written), any other language is a plus

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Join Julius Baer as an Application Operation, ensuring seamless operations of core banking systems through expert incident resolution, change coordination, and continuous process optimisation.

With a focus on stability and efficiency, you’ll play a key role in supporting critical applications, driving automation, and collaborating across IT and business teams in a dynamic financial environment.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Ensure the smooth operation of core banking applications, focusing on application management (2nd-level support)

• Process incident tickets generated by monitoring systems and the local service desk within agreed SLAs

• Perform routine data cleansing and maintenance of systems

• Maintain and update application operation documentation and knowledge base

• Provide support for batch job scheduling and monitoring (e.g., Automic AWA, Control-M, or similar tools)

YOUR PROFILE

• Completed IT training (Degree in Computer Science or equivalent IT-related certification)

• Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in application support

• Strong Linux knowledge (shell scripting is an advantage)

• Solid understanding of Windows OS at server level

• Familiarity with Java application servers, databases, and workload automation tools (AWA experience is a plus)

• ITIL Foundation certification

• Experience in batch job support and scheduling tools (Automic AWA, Control-M, or similar)

• Ideally, experience in banking or financial services with knowledge of financial products

• Proven ability to manage small teams or demonstrated project management skills

• Highly motivated, proactive, and eager to learn new concepts

jobs.title: Global Financial Accounting – Business Analyst 100%
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to spearhead the design, customization, and optimization of our core financial accounting processes. You will translate complex business requirements into scalable, compliant SAP solutions and ensure seamless integration with controlling (CO) and other core modules (MM, SD, FICO, RE-FX, AP, AR, ECCS) as well as several subledger own-developments.
You will support global operations over 35 entities as well as work on global projects.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Role objectives:

• Serve as the key interface between Finance Business, IT teams and other stakeholders

• Analyse and document business requirements related to SAP Finance processes

• Support the implementation and optimization of SAP solutions

• Drive process improvements and standardization across Finance functions

• Contribute to SAP S/4HANA transformation and related future initiatives

Responsibilities:

• Gather, analyze and document business and functional requirements

• Translate business needs into SAP finance solution designs and specifications

• Conduct process and gap analyses and recommend improvements

• Coordinate and support testing activities including defect resolution

• Collaborate with business stakeholders, SAP consultants and project teams throughout project lifecycles

Competencies:

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities

• Ability to bridge business requirements and technical solutions

• Strong stakeholder management and proven communication skills with the ability to decompose complex solutions into compelling storylines

• Strong understanding of key business processes related to accounting, data flows, interfaces and related configuration within SAP

• Proactive, collaborative and result-oriented mindset

YOUR PROFILE

• Education: Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Information Technology or related fields

• Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience as a Business Analyst or SAP Finance Consultant. Experience in a banking environment is an advantage

• Platform: Good knowledge of SAP R/3 or SAP S/4HANA Finance processes. SAP Finance certification is considered an advantage

• Key Skills: Deep understanding of accounting principles, record-to-report (R2R) processes, and complex financial reporting

• Soft Skills: Fluent in English and/or German (written and spoken), strong communication skills, high motivation and drive to get things done, hands-on mentality and entrepreneurial spirit, high flexibility

jobs.title: Platform Owner 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Julius Baer is looking for a forward-thinking Platform Owner to shape the future of Julius Baer`s enterprise technology platform offering. In this pivotal leadership role, you will define and drive the technical vision, roadmap, and operational excellence of the global data platform enabling data-driven decision-making and reporting across the bank.

You will play a central role in transforming how we build, scale, and govern our foundational data infrastructure - balancing innovation with robustness, agility with compliance, and speed with sustainability. Working closely with enterprise architecture, product owners, engineering teams, and external partners, you will ensure that platform capabilities consistently meet evolving business and consumer demands and adhere to stringent IT, risk, and regulatory standards.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Define and maintain the end-to-end technical vision, multi-year roadmap, and lifecycle strategy for the global data platform

• Gathering requirements and maintaining relationships with current and potential consumer base. Ensuring the technical vision and roadmap enables their current and future business ambitions

• Ensure platform scalability, reliability, performance, and security, embedding non-functional requirements (NFRs), observability, automation, and resilience-by-design principles

• Lead the prioritisation and delivery of platform features and capabilities, collaborating with Product Manager, Scrum Masters, Development Teams, System Architect, and Release Train Engineer to coordinate work across Agile teams

• Own the platform backlog, ensuring clear initiatives, features, and user stories. Prioritise the delivery, balancing trade-offs between innovation, tech debt reduction, and operational stability

• Serve as the primary technical escalation point for incidents, problems, audits, and risk findings related to the platform

• Establish and monitor SLAs, SLOs, and KPIs; leverage metrics and OKRs to measure platform health, usage, team performance, and business value delivered

• Drive standardisation, reuse, and simplification across the platform ecosystem to reduce complexity, improve interoperability, and accelerate time-to-market

• Coach and guide Technical Leads, and development teams, fostering best practices in coding, testing, deployment, and incident response

• Shape the target operating model for platform operations—including staffing, governance, RACI definitions, and handover processes—supporting sustainable growth and efficient run-models

• Represent the platform in executive forums and governance bodies, articulating progress, risks, investments, and strategic decisions to stakeholders across technology and business areas

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in technology roles within large, regulated enterprises—preferably in financial services

• Proven experience owning, leading or scaling large-scale data platforms – preferably big data technology

• Track record with defining and delivering technical platform visions and roadmaps in enterprise environments

• Hands-on exposure to modern data technologies such as Apache Spark / Iceberg, Trino, Kafka, Kubernetes, Snowflake/Databricks, Hadoop ecosystems, or equivalent

• Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines

• Track record in managing cross-functional initiatives involving multiple technical teams, vendors, and domains—demonstrating influence without direct authority

• Familiarity with risk and compliance frameworks applicable to Swiss financial institutions and experience addressing audit points or IT risk items

• Exceptional technical leadership and systems thinking, able to balance short-term delivery with long-term platform sustainability

• Strong communication skills on all levels. Ability to summarise complex issues for management, while also being able to discuss on a detail level with technical teams

• Expertise in software lifecycle governance, technical debt management, vulnerability remediation, and release approval processes

• Skilled in road-mapping, backlog refinement, dependency management, and translating business capabilities into actionable technical initiatives

• People person or comfortable with significant business / consumer interaction

• Solid understanding of non-functional requirements—performance, availability, recoverability, monitoring, logging, and security-by-default

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to make data-informed decisions using KPIs, telemetry, and feedback loops

• Fluent in English, both written and verbal; German language skills are a advantage

• Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, multinational environment with competing priorities

Julius Bär ist auf der Suche nach einem zukunftsweisenden Plattformbesitzer, der die Zukunft des Unternehmenstechnologie-Plattformangebots von Julius Bär gestaltet. In dieser zentralen Führungsrolle definieren und steuern Sie die technische Vision, den Fahrplan und die operative Exzellenz der globalen Datenplattform, die eine datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung und Berichterstattung in der gesamten Bank ermöglicht.

Sie werden eine zentrale Rolle bei der Transformation der Art und Weise spielen, wie wir unsere grundlegende Dateninfrastruktur aufbauen, skalieren und steuern - Innovation mit Robustheit, Agilität mit Compliance und Geschwindigkeit mit Nachhaltigkeit in Einklang bringen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Unternehmensarchitektur, Produkteigentümern, Engineering-Teams und externen Partnern stellen Sie sicher, dass die Plattformfähigkeiten die sich ändernden Geschäfts- und Verbraucheranforderungen konsequent erfüllen und strenge IT-, Risiko- und Regulierungsstandards einhalten.
